about_short_description.short_description: Inngest is the developer platform for easily building reliable workflows with zero infrastructure.

product.name: Durable Execution Platform
product.description: A platform that enables developers to build and run reliable, fault-tolerant workflows with automatic retries, parallel execution, and state management without managing infrastructure.

product.name: Flow Control Features
product.description: Built-in controls for managing concurrency, throttling, rate limiting, prioritization, batching, and debouncing in workflow executions.

product.name: Inngest Dev Server
product.description: An open source local development environment that simulates the Inngest platform for testing and debugging workflows on a developer's machine.

product.name: Observability and Recovery Tools
product.description: Tools integrated into the platform for monitoring, debugging, tracing, and recovering workflow executions in production.

product.name: Event-Driven Workflow Orchestration
product.description: A system to create and manage multi-step workflows triggered by events, with automatic state and orchestration management.
